description: Find Sigma Prep math worksheet topics (Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Geometry, Algebra 2, Precalculus, Calculus) that match what the teacher or student asked for. Use this first to get the topic id, the levels it offers and its question types, then call create_worksheet.
